arch_i.description: specify number of input neurons as a string-ified python list, eg. `[5]` or `[1, 1, 1]`

arch_z.description: specify number of output neurons as a string-ified python list, eg. `[1]` or `[1, 1]`

connector_function.description: specify how to connect your neurons; use `full_conn` if uncertain and refer to docs.aolabs.ai for more

connector_parameters.description: OPTIONAL-- some connector functions need extra specifications

arch.description: ALL OPTIONAL-- parameters for fine-tuned control

post.description: post an input (with optional learning modes instinct and label) to agent to evoke its output

requestBody.description: To invoke an Agent to get output, and perform miscellaneous tasks

agent_id.description: unique id of your agent, could be user or customer id

email.description: email tied to your developer account

INPUT.description: binary INPUT to Agent; number of binary digits is specified by Agent Arch I neurons

LABEL.description: OPTIONAL-- binary LABEL to Agent; if provided, Agent output will match LABEL and it will learn that input<>output mapping; number of binary digits is specified by Agent Arch Z neurons

INSTINCTS.description: OPTIONAL-- activates learning by instinct triggers specified in Agent Arch C neurons

US.description: Agents learn sequenced info by default, so set as True if data stream is UnSequenced and needs a reset state between each data input

states.description: number of times an Agent moves to the next state

DD.description: neuron look-up happens 1st according to discrimination distance (treating the lookup table 1-D weights)

Hamming.description: neuron look-up happens 2nd according to Hamming distance

Default.description: if neither DD or Hamming converge or are disabled, neuron will default to random binary response

control.description: ALL OPTIONAL-- parameters for fine-tuned control

request.description: OPTIONAL-- used for additional operations beyond invoking the agent, such as retrieving agent history, deleting the agent etc.

story.description: OUTPUT response of Agent to INPUT (will force-match LABEL if provided)

parameters.description: id of application kennel to operate on

US.description: Agents learn sequenced info by default, so set as True if data stream is UnSequenced and needs a reset state between each data input

states.description: number of times an Agent moves to the next state

Default.description: if neither DD or Hamming converge or are disabled, neuron will default to random binary response
